_comment: Codex registration of the agent-agnostic session-start trigger contract. Install at ~/.codex/hooks.json (user layer) or <repo>/.codex/hooks.json (project layer); or translate to inline [[hooks.SessionStart]] in ~/.codex/config.toml. Replace <absolute-path-to-repo> with this repo's absolute path. The command points at the SAME trigger script Claude Code uses — only the registration format differs. The script resolves the canonical path via helper/contract_lifecycle.py and injects the open-contract rule; it never creates the contract file.
